description: Computes an HMAC of input (decoded per encoding) using algo: md5, sha1, sha256, or sha512 (crc32 isn't offered — it's a checksum, not a cryptographic primitive HMAC composes with). key is used as its raw UTF-8 bytes, not decoded per encoding. Returns the MAC as lowercase hex.

input.description: data to authenticate, encoded per encoding

key.description: secret key, used as raw UTF-8 bytes

name: hash_hmac
